cases.input: Two runs pin one design but different dataset snapshots and random seeds; one supports and one challenges the hypothesis.
cases.expect: Both manifests and outcomes remain distinct and the hypothesis revision is unchanged.

cases.input: Attempt 1 fails and attempt 2 succeeds.
cases.expect: Both attempts remain append-only with retry lineage and separate evidence.

cases.input: A hypothesis revision is edited after result access to match observations.
cases.expect: Rejected; create a new explicit post-hoc WM-KNW-009 instance externally, never a revision of the preregistered hypothesis.

cases.input: A failed experiment is deleted after a successful rerun.
cases.expect: Rejected; failed run remains retained and citable.

cases.input: No observation exists for one outcome.
cases.expect: Run records missingness or coverage; it never asserts zero or no effect.

cases.input: Executed sample size and environment differ from the design.
cases.expect: Two typed deviations record planned and executed values with authority and evidence.

cases.input: One input dataset is more restricted than the run summary.
cases.expect: Run and derived result access retain the stricter evidence ceiling.

cases.input: A run supplies designVersionRef without pinKind or masterRef.
cases.expect: Rejected; the design pin must name its master and declare study-scoped-release or reusable-design-version.

cases.input: An attempt references a manifest whose manifestState is draft.
cases.expect: Rejected; only a frozen manifest with frozenAt may be referenced or digest-addressed.

cases.input: A planned run's draft manifest is edited three times before the first attempt starts.
cases.expect: The draft retains one draftManifestId across edits; manifestDigest is assigned only at freeze.

cases.input: Attempt 2 reruns after a runtime upgrade, so its frozen manifest differs from attempt 1's.
cases.expect: Attempt 2 carries its own frozen manifestDigest plus manifestDeltaFromRunManifest; attempt 1's manifest is unchanged.

cases.input: Attempt 2's manifest differs from the run manifest in an undeclared field.
cases.expect: Rejected; every divergence must appear in manifestDeltaFromRunManifest.

cases.input: An investigator reads attempt results for the first time.
cases.expect: A ResultAccessEvent is appended with accessedAt, actorRef, clockSourceRef and the hypothesis revision in scope.

cases.input: A hypothesis pin is asserted prospective but no ResultAccessEvent exists for the run.
cases.expect: Rejected; prospective status is clock-derived from the earliest logged result access and cannot be asserted.

cases.input: Hypothesis registration timestamp falls after the earliest ResultAccessEvent for its revision.
cases.expect: Rejected as prospective; the pin must be recorded post-hoc.

cases.input: A post-hoc proposition is appended as a successor revision of the sealed preregistered hypothesis.
cases.expect: Rejected; post-hoc formulation creates a new WM-KNW-009 instance typed post-hoc and may not reuse the preregistered identity.

cases.input: A hypothesis is refined before any ResultAccessEvent exists.
cases.expect: A successor revision is created under the same hypothesis identity and remains prospective.

cases.input: A protocol amendment in force for the whole run is recorded at run close with no single responsible attempt.
cases.expect: A deviation with scope run and no attemptId is accepted.

cases.input: A deviation is recorded with a free-text kind outside the enumeration.
cases.expect: Rejected; deviation kind must be one of the enumerated preregistration or conduct types.

cases.input: An unplanned-event deviation supplies plannedValue of 0 to satisfy the required field.
cases.expect: Rejected; absence of a planned value is a coded not-applicable, never a sentinel number.

cases.input: Twelve of twenty planned collection units yield no observation.
cases.expect: RunCoverage records planned and observed units with coded absence reason and missingness pattern; no observation is copied into the run.

cases.input: Uncollected units are summarized in the run as a zero observed value.
cases.expect: Rejected; absence is coded in RunCoverage and never expressed as zero or no effect.

cases.input: A run sets successClass to supported after its analysis.
cases.expect: Rejected; successClass is restricted to orchestration outcomes and carries no hypothesis support semantics.

cases.input: A run is closed after every attempt reaches failed.
cases.expect: The run completes with orchestration-failure; the outcome is neither negative, null nor inconclusive.

cases.input: A completed run's status is changed to superseded when a re-execution closes.
cases.expect: Rejected; supersession is recorded on the successor and as an append-only link, never as a status mutation on the immutable predecessor.

cases.input: A mistyped instrument reference on a completed run is corrected.
cases.expect: An erratum is appended to the original run; no new run occurrence is created and evidence aggregation still counts one run.

cases.input: A metadata correction is issued through supersede-run-by-reexecution with no new execution.
cases.expect: Rejected; record correction uses issue-run-erratum.

cases.input: WM-ACT-036 withdraws the owning study after two completed runs.
cases.expect: Both completed runs, their manifests, attempts and deviations remain resolvable and citable; nothing is removed.

cases.input: A run declares itself hypothesis-testing but records no hypothesisRevisionRefs.
cases.expect: Rejected; a hypothesis-testing run must pin at least one WM-KNW-009 revision in run and manifest.

cases.input: One input dataset is classified more restrictively than the run summary.
cases.expect: The run's effective access ceiling is raised to the strictest contributing classification and applies to derived results.

cases.input: An input dataset pin carries no accessClassificationRef.
cases.expect: Rejected; the access ceiling cannot be computed from an unclassified contributor.

cases.input: An attempt is created with an attemptId but no run-scoped sequence.
cases.expect: Rejected; attempt identity is the composite experimentRunId plus sequence.

cases.input: A failed attempt is purged under a storage policy after a successful rerun.
cases.expect: Rejected; the attempt's retentionClass and run-scoped key preserve it as queryable evidence.

cases.input: startedAt is recorded without an explicit UTC offset.
cases.expect: Rejected; all timestamps are RFC 3339 with seconds and explicit offset.

cases.input: An attempt's startedAt precedes its run's startedAt.
cases.expect: Rejected; attempt intervals must fall within the run interval and sequence must be monotonic in startedAt.

cases.input: A manifest omits calibrationRefs but pins everything else.
cases.expect: The manifest is accepted with reproducibilityGrade partially-reproducible and the omission is explicit.

cases.input: Randomness is recorded as the scalar 4711.
cases.expect: Rejected; randomness requires seed, generator, draw order and declared nondeterminism.

cases.input: A configuration pin embeds a credential value rather than a secret reference.
cases.expect: Rejected; configuration pins carry secret references only.

cases.input: A run with one successful attempt is declared reproducible on that basis.
cases.expect: Rejected; reproducibilityGrade is derived from manifest completeness, never from run outcome.

cases.input: A negative fixture is registered with no expectedCode.
cases.expect: Rejected; every negative case must name the rejection code it asserts.

cases.input: The candidate is submitted with at least one invariant having no fixture.
cases.expect: Rejected; validation policy requires at least one fixture per invariant and both polarities present.

cases.input: A run is completed with no actorRef or authorityRef on the transition.
cases.expect: Rejected; every lifecycle transition records its acting agent and authority.

cases.input: A recorder appends a conduct deviation under a steward's standing authorization.
cases.expect: The deviation retains both actorRef and authorityRef and remains append-only.
